root.label: Dollar Tree electronic balloon pump recall

events.label: Dollar Tree electronic balloon pump recall

slots.name: recalled quantity
slots.sentence: Dollar Tree has recalled more than 360,000 of its electronic balloon pumps because they can overheat, posing a burn risk, according to a recall report.

slots.name: overheating reports
slots.sentence: As of Oct. 1, Dollar Tree had received three reports of the pump overheating, with one report of flames outside the unit.

slots.name: injuries reported
slots.sentence: No injuries were reported, as of Oct. 1.

slots.name: sale price
slots.sentence: The electronic balloon pumps were sold at Dollar Tree stores nationwide and online on the Dollar Tree website and DoorDash between August 2025 and July 2026 for about $17, according to the recall report.

slots.name: model number
slots.sentence: The pumpkin's model number is "406198," according to the recall report.
